name: 蓝色图标＋橙色角标
prompt: Create one simple colorful Windows app icon for Windows Icon Toolkit, a utility that changes desktop icon corner badges. A flat medium-blue rounded square outline with a small solid warm-orange square at its lower-right corner, separated by a clean narrow white gap. Exactly two shapes and two colors. The large blue outline represents an app icon, the orange corner represents its editable badge. Friendly, balanced, distinctive, clean geometry, crisp edges, moderate corner radius, very readable at 24 pixels. Modern simple application icon, no surrounding background tile. Plain white square background, generous padding. Strictly flat solid colors; no gradients, no 3D, no bevel, no shadow, no glow, no texture, no extra shapes, no pencil, no letters, no text. One finished symbol, not a mockup or presentation.

name: 青绿图标＋编辑短笔
prompt: Create one clean simple colorful app icon for Windows Icon Toolkit. A solid teal rounded square with one simple ivory diagonal editing pencil touching its bottom-right corner. Keep the pencil broad and minimal, formed as one simple recognizable silhouette with a single small separation for the tip. Calm contemporary utility app identity, balanced proportions, clear at 24 pixels. Flat solid teal and warm ivory only, no gradients, no lighting, no 3D, no bevels, no shadows, no glow, no texture, no tiny decorative details. Plain white square background with generous whitespace around the complete icon. No text, no letters, no Windows logo, no presentation mockup. One finished app icon only.

name: 紫色图标＋切角
prompt: Create one minimal colorful application icon for Windows Icon Toolkit, a desktop icon customization utility. Exactly TWO simple geometric shapes, no shapes inside the main square. The missing corner and detached badge communicate editing or removing an icon overlay. Slightly softened corners, neat balanced whitespace, simple memorable silhouette, clear at 16 and 24 pixels. Flat solid muted violet and coral, not neon. No gradients, no dimensional shading, no 3D, no shadows, no glow, no texture, no particles, no pencil, no letters, no text. Pure white square background with generous padding. Single finished icon, not a mockup.
